# JasperGold & VC Formal Command Crosswalk

Quick-reference matrix mapping JasperGold (`jg`), VC Formal (`vcf`), and flavor-independent (`common`) commands supported by `informal shell`.

## Flavor-Independent Commands & Formal Apps (`common`)

| Command | Category | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `help` | Shell Utilities | Show Tcl command reference, options, and examples |
| `get_version` | Shell Utilities | Return the InFormal version string |
| `echo` | Shell Utilities | Print arguments separated by spaces to standard output |
| `session` | Shell Utilities | Dump the complete FPV session state as pretty-printed JSON |
| `set_lowering` | Environment, Vacuity, Lowering, and Proof Cache | Toggle opt-in SystemVerilog lowering relaxations |
| `check_assumptions` | Environment, Vacuity, Lowering, and Proof Cache | Check assumption satisfiability, UNSAT conflict cores, and 2QBF dead-end trap states |
| `set_vacuity` | Environment, Vacuity, Lowering, and Proof Cache | Enable or disable automatic environment and precondition vacuity checks |
| `set_engines` | Proving, Engines, and Reporting | Restrict the proof portfolio to named engines |
| `set_prove_cache` | Environment, Vacuity, Lowering, and Proof Cache | Enable or disable the content-addressed SHA-256 proof cache |
| `set_prove_cache_path` | Environment, Vacuity, Lowering, and Proof Cache | Get or set the proof cache directory path |
| `set_prove_cache_mode` | Environment, Vacuity, Lowering, and Proof Cache | Set proof cache read/write policy |
| `check_conn` | Formal Apps | Formal Connectivity App: verify pin-to-pin / muxed / pipelined CSV connectivity maps |
| `check_cov` | Formal Apps | Formal Coverage & UNR App: COI observability, branch/toggle dead-code detection, and waivers |
| `check_xprop` | Formal Apps | Exact 2-copy self-composition Formal X-Propagation App |
| `check_spv` | Formal Apps | Formal Security Path Verification (SPV) App: 2-safety non-interference and taint flow |
| `check_sec` | Formal Apps | Formal Sequential (SEC) and Combinational (LEC) Equivalence Checking App |
| `check_csr` | Formal Apps | Formal CSR / RAL Verification App from OpenTitan HJSON, CSV, or UVM RAL `.sv` |
| `check_protocol` | Formal Apps | 1-command Formal Bus Protocol VIP Generator (`tlul`, `axi4lite`, `apb`) |
| `why_cex` | Debugging, Complexity, and Abstraction | Compute a dynamic backward causal root-cause slice of a CEX or cover trace |
| `get_fv_complexity` | Debugging, Complexity, and Abstraction | Analyze cone-of-influence state bits, memories, and wide-arithmetic proof hotspots |
| `blackbox_assistant` | Debugging, Complexity, and Abstraction | Recommend or apply complexity-driven black-boxing of heavy submodules |
| `check_fv_setup` | Debugging, Complexity, and Abstraction | Audit formal setup completeness (clocks, resets, reset-less flops, undriven nets, abstractions) |
| `report_fv_setup` | Debugging, Complexity, and Abstraction | Alias for `check_fv_setup`: report formal setup audit findings |
| `get_reset_info` | Debugging, Complexity, and Abstraction | Report declared reset expression, async resets found, and reset-less registers |
| `abstract` | Debugging, Complexity, and Abstraction | Apply sound over-approximate counter jump abstractions to accelerate deep proofs |
| `report_abstractions` | Debugging, Complexity, and Abstraction | List active formal abstractions and their parameters |
| `set_abstractions` | Debugging, Complexity, and Abstraction | Clear or disable active formal abstractions |

## JasperGold (`jg`) Commands

| JasperGold (`jg`) | VC Formal / Equivalent | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clear` | VCF: start a new session | Reset the current session, clearing design files, elaboration, and properties |
| `analyze` | VCF: `analyze -format sverilog` or `read_file` | Collect SystemVerilog source files, filelists, defines, and include paths |
| `elaborate` | VCF: `elaborate <top>` / `read_file -top <top>` | Elaborate the analyzed SystemVerilog design with `svlang` |
| `clock` | VCF: `create_clock` | Declare primary or derived design clocks (or forward Tcl's built-in `clock`) |
| `reset` | VCF: `create_reset` | Declare the formal reset condition held in cycle 0 and released thereafter |
| `assert` | VCF: `fvassert`, `fvdisable`, `fvenable` | Add, enable, disable, or remove SVA assertions in a task |
| `assume` | VCF: `fvassume` | Add environment assumptions, promote helper assertions, or toggle/remove assumptions |
| `cover` | VCF: `fvcover` | Add, enable, disable, or remove SVA reachability cover properties |
| `prove` | VCF: `check_fv` | Run the engine portfolio on properties or tasks and print a verdict table |
| `get_property_list` | VCF: `get_props` | Query property names filtered by type, status, task, name, or disabled flag |
| `get_status` | — | Return the verification status string of a single property |
| `set_prove_time_limit` | VCF: `set_fml_var fml_max_time` | Set the session default per-property proof time limit |
| `set_prove_per_property_time_limit` | VCF: `set_fml_var fml_max_time` | Set the per-property proof time limit (alias for `set_prove_time_limit`) |
| `set_prove_total_time_limit` | — | Set or query the whole-batch wall-clock time limit across a `prove` run |
| `set_prove_effort` | VCF: `set_fml_var fml_effort` | Set or query the session engine proof effort level (`low`, `standard`, `high`, `max`) |
| `set_prove_orchestration` | — | Set or query two-pass proof orchestration (`auto`, `on`, `off`) |
| `set_engine_mode` | Common: `set_engines` | Map JasperGold engine mode letters (`Ht`, `Hp`, `B`, `N`, ...) to InFormal engines |
| `report` | VCF: `report_fv` | Print or export property tables, CSV summaries, design info, or per-property details |
| `get_design_info` | JG: `report -design` | Inspect elaborated design counts (flops, latches, memories, clocks) and model sizes |
| `get_property_info` | — | Inspect one property's status, engine stats, COI cone, or minimal proof core |
| `get_stats` | — | Return per-property proof statistics (engine, wall/CPU time, depth, peak memory) as JSON |
| `stopat` | VCF: `snip_driver` | Cut signals from their RTL drivers so they become unconstrained free inputs in a task |
| `task` | JG: `get_task_list` | Create, edit, switch, list, or delete isolated formal verification tasks |
| `get_task_list` | JG: `task -list` | Return the Tcl list of all tasks in the session |
| `visualize` | — | Return the VCD trace path for a CEX or cover and optionally launch `$INFORMAL_WAVE_VIEWER` |
| `include` | Standard Tcl: `source` | Source another Tcl file in the global scope (JasperGold alias for `source`) |
| `set_proofgrid_per_engine_max_jobs` | — | Vendor proof-grid tuning command (accepted and ignored with a note) |
| `set_proofgrid_per_engine_max_local_jobs` | — | Vendor proof-grid tuning command (accepted and ignored with a note) |
| `set_proofgrid_max_local_jobs` | — | Vendor proof-grid tuning command (accepted and ignored with a note) |
| `set_proofgrid_max_jobs` | — | Vendor proof-grid tuning command (accepted and ignored with a note) |
| `set_proofgrid_mode` | — | Vendor proof-grid mode command (accepted and ignored with a note) |
| `set_max_trace_length` | VCF: `set_fml_var fml_max_depth` | Set or query the persistent BMC unrolling bound (`0`/`off` clears) |

## VC Formal (`vcf`) Commands

| VC Formal (`vcf`) | JasperGold / Equivalent | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `set_blackbox` | JG: `elaborate -bbox_m / -bbox_i` | Mark modules or cell instances as black boxes before elaboration |
| `set_fml_appmode` | — | Select VC Formal application mode (`FPV`) |
| `set_fml_var` | JG: `set_prove_time_limit` / `set_prove_effort` / `set_max_trace_length` | Set VC Formal session variable (`fml_max_time`, `fml_effort`, `fml_max_depth`) |
| `read_file` | JG: `analyze` + `elaborate` | Analyze and elaborate SystemVerilog sources in one command |
| `analyze` | JG: `analyze -sv12` | Analyze SystemVerilog source files in VC Formal style |
| `elaborate` | JG: `elaborate -top` | Elaborate the analyzed top module in VC Formal style |
| `create_clock` | JG: `clock` | Declare a design clock signal in VC Formal style |
| `snip_driver` | JG: `stopat` | Cut signals from their RTL drivers (VC Formal equivalent of `stopat`) |
| `create_reset` | JG: `reset -expression` | Declare the active-high or active-low formal reset signal |
| `sim_run` | Handled automatically by `reset` | Accept VC Formal reset simulation directive (reset is modeled natively) |
| `sim_save_reset` | Handled automatically by `reset` | Accept VC Formal save-reset directive (reset is modeled natively) |
| `fvassert` | JG: `assert -name` | Add an SVA assertion in VC Formal style |
| `fvassume` | JG: `assume` | Add an SVA assumption or promote a helper assertion in VC Formal style |
| `fvcover` | JG: `cover -name` | Add an SVA cover property in VC Formal style |
| `fvdisable` | JG: `assert -disable` | Disable properties matching a glob pattern |
| `fvenable` | JG: `assert -enable` | Re-enable previously disabled properties matching a glob pattern |
| `check_fv` | JG: `prove` | Run the engine portfolio on VC Formal properties |
| `report_fv` | JG: `report` | Print verification results table in VC Formal style |
| `get_props` | JG: `get_property_list` | Return Tcl list of properties filtered by type and status |
